source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 2--4, especially the model summary and lower-bound sections
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The public version studies goodness-of-fit in a Gaussian sequence model with known singular functions and noisy observed singular values, obtaining nonasymptotic upper and lower separation-radius bounds.

The paper studies inverse Gaussian sequence testing with additional noisy operator observations, establishes nonasymptotic minimax radii, and uses Bonferroni adaptation with an unavoidable logarithmic deterioration.

The paper gives bootstrap critical values for shape restrictions in conditional-moment models by approximating a subset of the local parameter space and establishes uniform validity in its stated framework.
The paper develops projection-based uniformly valid, asymptotically nonconservative tests for shape restrictions that form convex cones, exploiting cone monotonicity.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the experiment implementable: specify a P-independent basis or a deterministic probability-weighted basis construction, define h's coefficient vector, and include any basis-estimation error in the split statistic and threshold.

Replace Proposition 1 with an explicitly cited setup premise, or formally state the latent single-NCO model, completeness, and regularity assumptions and prove only a genuinely new restriction-to-observable corollary.

For the frontier OEQ, commit a small explicit positive-table worked instance for the joint DCT perturbation and state the candidate phase variables to be balanced; this would sharpen the converse handle without turning it into an analogy-based conjecture.
